input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, user management domain. It serves API Consumer, Admin, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include admin, auth, auth. Core business data revolves around Github, Outlook, OutlookLog, User. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a Admin, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to create and manage tasks, so that I can organize and track my work effectively.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage admin operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage github operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
